## 👋 About me

I'm Isaac, a 20-year-old builder exploring **AI, software, business and e-commerce**. I like turning unclear ideas into useful products, workflows and experiments while learning the business behind them.

🧠 I have ADHD, and curiosity often sends me deep into documentation, tools and research rabbit holes. I enjoy connecting ideas from different fields and understanding how things really work.

⚡ I learn continuously by building: researching, testing, documenting what works, then improving.

## 🛒 E-commerce execution

I work across the e-commerce process, from product research and supplier sourcing to storefront, branding, conversion and acquisition. Hands-on experience with Shopify, WordPress and WooCommerce has taught me how product, distribution, operations and customer behavior connect. It is also where I keep learning business through real execution.

## 🚧 What I'm building

I'm currently building a stealth software project at the intersection of **AI, creation and digital products**.

> **Rethink how people turn ideas into real products.**

🔒 The concept and product mechanics remain private for now. More when it's ready.

## 📡 Building in public

I plan to document the journey **from zero to public launch** — including the experiments, decisions, mistakes and lessons along the way.

- 🎥 Videos on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@IsaacPolignac), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/isaacpolignac) and [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@isaacpolignac)
- ✍️ Ideas, research and progress updates on [X](https://x.com/isaacpolignac) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/isaac-polignac-683948430/)
- 🧱 Repository updates once the public build phase begins
- 🛠️ Useful tools and experiments released as open-source projects

The goal is to share the real process, not only the polished result, while keeping the project's core private.
